title: 产品成为霓虹灯下的梦想
prompt: a surreal-realistic digital artwork of a product from the brand [Brand name]. The product should be glowing with neon outlines, stylized like a high-contrast 3D render. Place it in a dreamlike environment inspired by the brand’s identity, color scheme, and culture. Use soft shadows, deep blacks, and intense lighting for dramatic effect.
description: Nano Banana Pro 能创作出霓虹灯轮廓闪耀的超现实数字艺术作品，非常适合品牌推广和产品可视化，在娱乐和广告行业中打造梦幻视觉效果。Nano Banana Pro 则以高对比度3D渲染和强烈光影，为品牌形象注入戏剧性魅力，适用于创意景观设计。
